publicReleaseNotes: Nook 0.1.0: the first public release of the self-hosted team workspace (private channels, direct messages, threads, versioned decisions, commitments and calm attention) on one Cloudflare Worker.

migrations.buyerSteps: Part of the initial schema. A new installation applies every migration in filename order through rer setup or rer deploy; keep every applied migration byte unchanged.

agentUpdateInstructions: First public release; there is no earlier public version to update from. Installations made from earlier private source keep their state: back up with rer export, keep every applied migration byte, and apply only new migrations in filename order as OPERATIONS.md describes. Never reset populated state to update.
